subject: SOC 2 renewal: evidence choreography, dedicated node commitment & contract term tweak
message_1_subject: Re: Renewal scope and SOC 2 refresh - sequencing question
message_1_body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick chat earlier. As NovumTech prepares to renew (anniversary Sept 30), our security team flagged two items we need resolved before legal will sign: an updated SOC 2 evidence index that maps to last 12 months of log retention, and confirmation of where audit artifacts will be staged for transfer (S3 vs. secure SharePoint). We also want to discuss capacity for a short-term throughput bump during our busiest end-of-quarter reporting window — likely a 30% increase for 2 weeks.

Can your team confirm: 
- A point of contact for evidence staging and expected delivery format (spreadsheet + object listing preferred)
- Whether Redwood can allocate a dedicated GPU node pool for the Q4 surge and approximate lead time
- Any term changes you need to propose for the renewal (we're open to a 12 -> 18 month option if it buys predictable pricing)

Attaching our initial evidence checklist (see attachment: SOC2_Evidence_Index.xlsx). Can you loop in the right people on your side?

Best,
Elena
Director, Security & Compliance
NovumTech
message_2_subject: Re: Renewal scope and SOC 2 refresh - sequencing question
message_2_body:
Hi Elena — thanks for sending the checklist and the heads-up on the timeline. Looping in Kimberly (security compliance lead) and Marissa (renewals) who will take point. Quick answers below and then we can schedule a short working session to run the choreography: 

- Evidence staging: we can provide a manifest (spreadsheet + SHA256 checksums) and a temporary, access-restricted S3 bucket for transfer. Marissa will coordinate credentials and an upload window.
- Dedicated node pool: we can reserve a 2-node dedicated pool for your anticipated 30% burst. Lead time is ~10 business days to finalize provisioning and network peering for private transfers.
- Term option: we can offer an 18-month renewal with a 4% discount vs 12 months; details to be included in the SOW.

Next steps I propose:
1) 30-minute evidence choreography call (Marissa — can you propose 3 time slots?)
2) Kimberly to share a mapping of the SOC 2 controls we can pre-validate against the evidence index
3) Draft SOW for the dedicated node commitment and term amendment for NovumTech legal review

Thanks — will follow up with calendar invites.

Cheers,
Sofia
Head of Customer Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
message_3_subject: SOC 2 evidence mapping + draft SOW for dedicated node (attached)
message_3_body:
Hi Elena / Tom — good to meet you virtually. Following Sofia's note, attaching two items: (1) a pre-populated evidence mapping template that aligns Redwood control statements to the columns in your SOC2_Evidence_Index.xlsx and (2) a draft SOW (Dedicated_Node_SOW_v1.pdf) that covers the 2-node reserve, expected throughput uplift, and the 18-month term pricing.

High-level callouts from the mapping:
- Log retention: we can export rolling audit logs for the 12-month window in NDJSON or gzipped CSV; manifest will include timestamps and checksums.
- Evidence handoff: we recommend a 48-hour staging window in the S3 bucket followed by a full handoff zip for your auditors — we can automate via a signed URL and an index file.
- Isolation: the dedicated pool will be single-tenant at the workload level and we will provide ACLs and an access audit trail for all artifact access.

SOW summary (terms in the PDF):
- Capacity: 2 dedicated nodes (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) reserved 24/7 for the duration of the commitment
- Surge: allow one additional transient node for two 14-day windows per 12 months (subject to 7 day provisioning lead)
- Term: 18 months starting on renewal effective date; pricing includes a 4% volume discount vs the 12-month baseline
- Evidence support: 5 days of professional services to assist with evidence packaging and secure transfer (included)

Action items for NovumTech:
- Confirm you want the 2-node reserve + surge windows (reply with yes/no)
- If yes, please sign the SOW (DocuSign link included below) or send PO — we can accept a PO to preliminarily reserve capacity.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/AA12345

I'll hold the SOW for 5 business days. If it helps, we can also propose a shorter pilot term with a pro-rated node commit.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

-----Original Attachment(s)-----
- SOC2_Evidence_Index.xlsx (from NovumTech)
- Dedicated_Node_SOW_v1.pdf (attached by Kimberly)
message_4_subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence mapping + draft SOW for dedicated node (attached)
message_4_body:
Sofia / Kimberly / Marissa — thanks for the clear package and the quick turnaround. NovumTech is comfortable moving forward with the 2-node reserve plus the two 14-day surge windows. Approve the 18-month term with the proposed discount.

Procurement will issue a PO today (attached when sent). For legal, we have one minor change request to the SOW: a 30-day rollback clause for evidence custody if we find gaps during the initial handoff. Marissa, we'll need coordination on the S3 upload window — Tom will own the PO and scheduling.

Next steps we expect from Redwood:
- Finalized SOW with the rollback clause included and a DocuSign route (we will sign electronically)
- Pre-provision the dedicated nodes (or at least reserve capacity) pending PO receipt
- Schedule the evidence choreography call — available Mon/Tue next week 10-12 PT

I've asked procurement to send the PO to lauren@redwood.com and copy sofia@redwood.com.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.
Elena
Director, Security & Compliance
NovumTech

-----Attachment stub-----
- NovumTech_PO_1234.pdf (to be attached by procurement)
